subject: Multi-slot virtual onsite for Priya Shah — run-of-show proposal & shadow request
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@example.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@redwoodclient.com>
Date: Wed, 1 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Multi-slot virtual onsite for Priya Shah — run-of-show proposal & shadow request

Hi Priya / team —

Thanks again for taking the time to go through the process with Redwood. Below is a proposed run-of-show for the virtual onsite (full loop) on Friday, May 10. The candidate (Priya) is in PDT; I’ve sequenced panels to minimize context switching and inserted a 15m buffer between deep dives.

Proposed (all times PDT):
- 09:30–10:00 — Introductions / hiring manager + TL (Alex Chen)
- 10:15–11:00 — System design (Marissa)
- 11:15–11:45 — Coding challenge (pair) (Marcus)
- 12:00–12:30 — Lunch / break (async test)
- 12:45–13:15 — ML conceptual + tradeoffs (Naomi)
- 13:30–14:00 — On-call / reliability discussion (Laura)

Asks / notes:
- Laura, would you be willing to act as the debrief scribe and shadow for context handoffs? We’d like a single doc with per-interviewer scores and a 3–5 line signal/concern summary to speed hiring committee sync.
- Marissa / Marcus: please confirm tool preference for the coding exercise (CoderPad vs shared Colab). If CoderPad, I’ll provision a temp pad and attach link.
- Priya: attaching a short candidate prep guide and your resume I have on file. Can you confirm the times above work? Also flag any accommodations we should request.

Attachments: candidate_prep_guide.pdf (stub), Priya_Resume.pdf (stub)

Thanks — I’ll lock calendar invites once we confirm.

Sean Gallagher
Talent Operations | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Multi-slot virtual onsite for Priya Shah — run-of-show proposal & shadow request

Hi Sean / Alex / team —

Thanks — the proposed timeline looks great. I confirm availability for May 10 at the times listed. I prefer CoderPad for the coding exercise (I’m comfortable there). No accommodations needed right now.

A couple quick Qs:
- For the lunch/async test slot, is that expected to be an asynchronous take-home or a short GitHub exercise I return same day?
- For the ML discussion, would it be useful for me to share a short 1-2 slide summary of a recent project (I can send by Thursday)?

Attached my latest resume (updated). Looking forward to it.

Best,

Subject: Re: Multi-slot virtual onsite for Priya Shah — run-of-show proposal & shadow request

+1 on CoderPad.

Sean — I can run system design at 10:15. Marcus, if you take the pair coding at 11:15 I’ll prep the prompt and send it here by Thursday.

Laura — happy to have you scribe. Suggested debrief doc layout: one section per interviewer with (1) numeric score (1–5), (2) top 3 evidence bullets, (3) pass/hold/strong. I’ll paste a template below and link a live doc for post-interview async comments so the hiring committee can review before Friday EOD.

Score:

Signal / Concerns (2–3 lines):

Also, can someone confirm whether Alex will join introductions or join asynchronously for the hiring manager debrief? Alex: can you confirm?

All —

Thanks for the quick confirmations. I’ve locked the calendar invites (see attached .ics and links below) and created the debrief doc (editable for interviewers only). Please review the short bullets on the template ahead of time; full async comments go in the linked doc immediately after your session.

Confirmed schedule (PDT):
- 09:30–09:55 — Intro / hiring manager (Alex joins) — Google Meet link in invite
- 10:15–11:00 — System design (Marissa) — CoderPad link in invite
- 11:15–11:45 — Pair coding (Marcus) — CoderPad
- 12:00–12:30 — Lunch / short take-home (same-day GitHub gist) — instructions in invite
- 12:45–13:15 — ML tradeoffs (Naomi)
- 13:30–14:00 — Reliability / on-call (Laura) — Laura is debrief scribe

Action items:
- Marcus / Marissa: paste CoderPad prompts here by Thursday EOD.
- Laura: I made you owner of the debrief doc (link). Please create the per-interviewer sections during the day so others can add comments in real time.
- Alex: will you join the intro slot? If not, please add any hiring manager notes to the doc after the loop.
- Priya: please upload 1–2 slides if you want to present a recent project; Slack me for the presenter pin if needed.
